nodes.title: Prompt1
widgets_values: In a softly lit bedroom, she lies comfortably on a bed. The atmosphere is serene, the sheets crisp and inviting. She is dressed in a casual white outfit, relaxing in the tranquil environment.

nodes.title: Prompt2
widgets_values: She shifts her position slightly, maintaining a sense of grace and ease. Her gaze is contemplative, as if lost in thought. The background is calm, with a hint of decor adding to the peaceful setting.

nodes.title: Prompt3
widgets_values: Her posture is relaxed yet elegant, as she leans on one arm. The camera captures the gentle curves and lines of her form, enhancing the sense of calm and relaxation in the room.

nodes.title: Prompt4
widgets_values: Her hand gently supports her head, a subtle sign of peaceful introspection. She seems completely at ease in this private space, drawing the viewer into the intimate moment.

nodes.title: Prompt5
widgets_values: The soft fabric of her attire contrasts with the crispness of the white sheets. The simplicity of the scene creates a feeling of warmth and tranquility, allowing the viewer to bask in the quiet serenity.

nodes.title: Prompt6
widgets_values: The camera slowly zooms in, capturing the delicate details and textures around her. Each frame emphasizes the harmonious blend of lighting and shadow, creating a visual lullaby.
